summary: The cut is clean, but the head and torso twitch sharply at 4.03-4.09 and the arms turn stiff and twinned with a near-static body for the rest of the strip.

faults.what: Head snaps from facing camera to a chin-up turn to the side within 2 frames (4.00 to 4.06), and the torso and arms shift sideways at the same time. The cough has no anticipation and reads as a pose pop rather than a slumped cough.
faults.fix: Add 3-4 frames of ease-in (a head dip or chest draw-back) before the cough, and ease the head and torso over more frames.

faults.what: Head returns from the up-and-side turn (4.29-4.33) to facing front by 4.36, and the torso and arms jump back with it. The second cough reads as the same snap, repeated.
faults.fix: Smooth the return over 4-6 frames with a settle, and vary the second cough's size or direction.

faults.what: Between coughs (2.69-2.93) both arms hang in a stiff, near-symmetrical pose with the fists on the thighs and almost no motion. The pose does not read as slumped or sick.
faults.fix: Add a slump in the spine and shoulders, offset the arms, and add subtle breathing.
